mapper.sql: id, order_no, offer_id, item_a_id, item_b_id, owner_a_id, owner_b_id, delivery_mode, status, a_delivered_time, b_delivered_time, a_confirmed_time, b_confirmed_time, a_track_no, b_track_no, cancel_reason, dispute_reason, dispute_result, complete_time, create_time, update_time, tenant_id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO twelve_exchange_order (order_no, offer_id, item_a_id, item_b_id, owner_a_id, owner_b_id, delivery_mode, status, create_time, update_time, tenant_id) VALUES (#{orderNo}, #{offerId}, #{itemAId}, #{itemBId}, #{ownerAId}, #{ownerBId}, #{deliveryMode}, #{status}, NOW(), NOW(), #{tenantId})
mapper.update: UPDATE twelve_exchange_order SET a_delivered_time = NOW(), a_track_no = #{trackNo}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{orderId} AND owner_a_id = #{userId} AND a_delivered_time IS NULL AND status IN ('created', 'delivering') AND tenant_id = #{tenantId}

UPDATE twelve_exchange_order SET b_delivered_time = NOW(), b_track_no = #{trackNo}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{orderId} AND owner_b_id = #{userId} AND b_delivered_time IS NULL AND status IN ('created', 'delivering') AND tenant_id = #{tenantId}

UPDATE twelve_exchange_order SET status = CASE WHEN a_delivered_time IS NOT NULL AND b_delivered_time IS NOT NULL THEN 'pending_confirm' ELSE 'delivering' END, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{orderId} AND status IN ('created', 'delivering') AND tenant_id = #{tenantId}

UPDATE twelve_exchange_order SET a_confirmed_time = NOW(), update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{orderId} AND owner_a_id = #{userId} AND a_confirmed_time IS NULL AND status = 'pending_confirm' AND tenant_id = #{tenantId}

UPDATE twelve_exchange_order SET b_confirmed_time = NOW(), update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{orderId} AND owner_b_id = #{userId} AND b_confirmed_time IS NULL AND status = 'pending_confirm' AND tenant_id = #{tenantId}

UPDATE twelve_exchange_order SET status = 'completed', complete_time = NOW(), update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{orderId} AND status = 'pending_confirm' AND a_confirmed_time IS NOT NULL AND b_confirmed_time IS NOT NULL AND tenant_id = #{tenantId}

UPDATE twelve_exchange_order SET status = 'cancelled', cancel_reason = #{reason}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{orderId} AND (owner_a_id = #{userId} OR owner_b_id = #{userId}) AND status IN ('created', 'delivering') AND a_delivered_time IS NULL AND b_delivered_time IS NULL AND tenant_id = #{tenantId}

UPDATE twelve_exchange_order SET status = 'cancelled', cancel_reason = #{reason}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{orderId} AND status IN ('created', 'delivering') AND a_delivered_time IS NULL AND b_delivered_time IS NULL AND tenant_id = #{tenantId}

UPDATE twelve_exchange_order SET status = 'disputed', dispute_reason = #{reason}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{orderId} AND (owner_a_id = #{userId} OR owner_b_id = #{userId}) AND status IN ('delivering', 'pending_confirm') AND tenant_id = #{tenantId}

UPDATE twelve_exchange_order SET status = 'completed', complete_time = NOW(), a_confirmed_time = IFNULL(a_confirmed_time, NOW()), b_confirmed_time = IFNULL(b_confirmed_time, NOW()), dispute_result = #{result}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{orderId} AND status = 'disputed' AND tenant_id = #{tenantId}
UPDATE twelve_exchange_order SET status = 'cancelled', dispute_result = #{result}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{orderId} AND status = 'disputed' AND tenant_id = #{tenantId}

UPDATE twelve_exchange_order SET status = 'completed', complete_time = NOW(), a_confirmed_time = IFNULL(a_confirmed_time, NOW()), b_confirmed_time = IFNULL(b_confirmed_time, NOW()), update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{orderId} AND status = 'pending_confirm' AND tenant_id = #{tenantId}
mapper.select:
SELECT o.*, ia.title AS item_a_title, ib.title AS item_b_title, ua.nick_name AS owner_a_name, ub.nick_name AS owner_b_name FROM twelve_exchange_order o LEFT JOIN twelve_exchange_item ia ON ia.id = o.item_a_id LEFT JOIN twelve_exchange_item ib ON ib.id = o.item_b_id LEFT JOIN sys_user ua ON ua.user_id = o.owner_a_id LEFT JOIN sys_user ub ON ub.user_id = o.owner_b_id
ORDER BY CASE WHEN o.status = 'disputed' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, o.id DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{size}

SELECT COUNT(*) AS totalOrders, SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS completedOrders, SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'cancelled' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS cancelledOrders, SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'disputed' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS disputedOrders, SUM(CASE WHEN status IN ('created', 'delivering', 'pending_confirm') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS activeOrders FROM twelve_exchange_order
tenant_id = #{tenantId}
